_meta.title: repro_20260220_v7p2p2_eps_decay_fix
_meta.summary: V7P2P2 reproducibility config: reduce eps_decay from 4500 to 200 to match 150-300 episode training horizon.
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v7p2p2 --episodes 150 --out v7p2p2_smoke150 --device cuda --progress
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v7p2p2 --models v7p2p2_smoke150 --runs 3 --out v7p2p2_smoke150 --progress
notes: Single-variable change relative to v7p1 baseline: train.eps_decay=200.
Workflow gate: smoke150 (train) + runs=3 (infer) before any full evaluation.
Primary objective: shorter path, lower compute time, smoother trajectory.
